newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Northwest Air outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Northwest Air outperform.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co analyst Steve Lewins said Tuesday he maintains his outperform rating on Northwest Airlines Corp, seeing the possible sale by KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV of its stake in Northwest as a "positive."

-- Northwest and KLM said recently they have been in discussions regarding a possible extension of their marketing and operating alliance and issues regarding an ownership dispute related to KLM's stake in Northwest.

-- "Even though the ownership controversy has not impacted the operational alliance...it has scared some investors," Gruntal said in a report. "(Possible) sale of the shares by KLM would remove a perceived 'pall' on the shares."
